readings: Join each budget line to its event where budget.link_to_event exactly matches event.event_id, dropping lines without a matching event. Keep only lines with spent > 6.0. For each event.status represented by at least one kept line, show the status, the unrounded average of amount - spent across kept lines with nonmissing values (blank if none), and the count of all kept lines.

Join each budget line to its event where budget.link_to_event exactly matches event.event_id, dropping lines without a matching event. Keep only lines with spent >= 6.0. For each event.status represented by at least one kept line, show the status, the unrounded average of amount - spent across kept lines with nonmissing values (blank if none), and the count of all kept lines.
queries:
SELECT e.status,
       COALESCE(AVG(b.amount - b.spent), '') AS average_remaining,
       COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status

SELECT e.status,

       COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.spent >= 6.0
GROUP BY e.status
